name: mibee-rec-web
description: Preact SPA sources for mibee-rec. Bundled by esbuild at Rust build time; no runtime Node dependency.

comments.purpose: These are BUILD-TIME devDependencies only. esbuild bundles preact into crates/web/static/app.bundle.js, which is then inlined into index.html. The shipped binary embeds index.html and has zero Node/npm runtime dependency.
comments.build: On Linux: cargo build invokes crates/web/build.rs which runs tools/esbuild-linux-x64. Run `npm install` in this directory first so preact is resolvable.
